# DroneOps

> DroneOps is a drone fleet operations platform for mission planning, telemetry, geofencing, maintenance, incidents, reports and administration.

## Primary Website

- [DroneOps deployed application](https://droneops-five.vercel.app/)

## Key Areas

- Dashboard: operational overview, mission status and fleet readiness.
- Telemetry and Geofences: live tracking, replay and operational zone review.
- Missions: route planning, drone assignment and mission lifecycle management.
- Fleet: drone registration, drone profile and availability management.
- Maintenance: service schedules, maintenance records and readiness controls.
- Incidents and Reports: safety records, evidence handling and operational reports.
